acceptances.reason: Live on porchandparty901.com: 4 publications (two FAQ answer pages on Memphis balloon-garland and Christmas-decorating cost, one baby-shower planning checklist guide, and the /answers/ route) plus 5 section-index routes that the gate already holds outside the publication cap. A red build cannot un-publish them, and this gate could not have stopped them - it rewrote its own ledger on every run, so a blocked run cleared itself on the next invocation and only a clean CI checkout ever saw the block. Accepted once, with the gate now read-only and authority-daily.yml advancing the baseline only after the gate clears, so the cap of 1 publication per week applies for real from here. This accepts the count, not the judgement: the library sits 8 pages above its maintainable ceiling of 104 and all 112 pages share a lastmod inside 7 days, which is a date-bump pattern rather than a refresh. Both warnings stand unresolved.
